matching.direct_view: gold types ['BIRTH_PLACE', 'CADASTRAL_REF', 'CASE_ID', 'CONTRACT_ID', 'INDIRECT'] treated as ignore regions
matching.leak_rate: gold word tokens not fully covered by any masked span (type-agnostic)
matching.lenient: any overlap + compatible type (recall per gold span, precision per predicted span)
matching.neg_fp_rate: negative look-alike spans overlapped by any masked span
